title: Twelve Winters and One Short Meter
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：energy　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 energy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandmother ① stored an energy that no engineer in the valley would have measured, and she said the storing was the whole of the winter. The ② energy, meaning the power itself and not the fuel, ran twelve winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; an energy, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ energy in that valley had the same short meter beside it, and the ④ energy at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An energy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; my grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills twelve winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the energy was the whole of the body, meaning the strength and not the power. The ⑥ energy, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a body that everybody needs and nobody measures; energy, he said, is either something you store or the only word that means both power and strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ energy had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short meter. The ⑧ energy of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one valley and twelve winters of measuring; energy, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to measure. She said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ energy I remember is the one measured in the chart, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. An ⑩ energy, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being measured; every energy, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a power. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 能量（指山谷里每一处旁边的那一份）
B. n. 能量（指那种能量本身，与燃料相对）
C. 固定搭配：store energy 储存能量
D. n. 能量（指留给冬天的那一份）
E. n. 能源（抽象总称，指一个山谷的用能之事）
F. n. 能量（指图表上写到、被标出的那一份）
G. n. 精力；活力（指人身上人人都需要却无人计量的那样东西）
H. n. 精力（抽象总称，指人人都需要却无人计量的那种力量）

items.q: stored an energy that no engineer in the valley would have measured

answers.why: store energy 意为“储存能量”，1961 年祖母储存了一份山谷里没有一位工程师肯计量的能量。
energy 意为“能量”，指那种能量本身而不是燃料，它经过了十二个冬天而在簿子上没有数字。
energy 意为“能量”，指山谷里每一处旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一只短短的计量表。
energy 意为“能量”，指留给冬天的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
energy 意为“精力、活力”，指人身上人人都需要却无人计量的那样东西，叔叔说这份精力就是那具身体的全部。
energy 意为“精力”，指人人都需要却无人计量的那种力量而不是那种能量，是身体里人人都需要、却无人计量的东西。
energy 意为“能量”，指图表上写到、被标出的那一份，到 1968 年这一份成了图表里的一行。
energy 意为“能源”，祖母一月写道，整件事的用能之事是一个山谷和十二个冬天的计量。
energy 意为“能量”，我记得的是图表上标出的那一份，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一份。
energy 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一份能量是唯一会因为被好好计量而变得更好的东西。
